👤 About Me

Curious by Nature. Building with Purpose.

A statistics student learning to turn ideas into useful digital experiences.

2029
B.Sc. Statistics
Class Year

Hello! I'm Joseph, the mind behind {Jentle}

I'm a B.Sc. Statistics student at the Federal University of Lafia, Nigeria (2025–2029), and an aspiring software developer. My interests bring together technology, programming, and data.

I learn through hands-on projects: a WhatsApp bot, a micro-app, this website, and JentleLink — my own venture for software solutions and internet services. I also explain football and everyday statistics through numbers on ItodoStats, and I'm developing Imagine That, a YouTube channel for cinematic What If stories.

  • ✔ Web pages with HTML, CSS & JavaScript
  • ✔ Data analysis with Excel, SPSS & Python
  • ✔ Automation with JavaScript & Node.js
  • ✔ Football data and everyday statistics on ItodoStats
  • ✔ Software & internet services — JentleLink
  • ✔ Cinematic What If videos — Imagine That
